whole_review_estimate_limit: mechanical input reconstruction only; no full review model run and no measured full-review recall

all_tool_return_snapshot.protocol: o200k_base, actual tool output text in local active task journal since this request. Includes setup, scripts/metadata output, errors/truncation text, source, review, lookup and status outputs. Excludes system/developer prompts, prior conversation already in context, user input, assistant reasoning/generated scripts and generation/billing. Snapshot excludes its own in-flight tool response and later delivery calls.

interpretation: Material accounting is not all task input. All-tool snapshot additionally includes measured preparation overhead and is not total session usage or billing. Same-agent targeted review is not independent or a semantic recall estimate.
